text:
Baseline constant steps give R=2/3; Gaussian gives 0.7071. Goal: maximize R=L2/Linf of f*f (exact via np.convolve, knot formula).

What worked: Local nonparametric optimization beat the Gaussian. p0005 (N=201, Gaussian init, L-BFGS-B on exact R, restarts) reached 0.820996, sparse (64% zeros, max/mean 6.28, f*f peak at 0.557 of support). p0007 (generalized Gaussian exp(-|t/s|^p) scan, N=8001) reached 0.721258, confirming p≈2 best in that family. Stochastic multiscale block search around a dense N=50 shape was the strongest early line: p0006 0.833314, p0002 0.818329, p0004 0.780783.

What failed: p0003 (low-dim symmetric K=15 control-point (1+1)-evolution, N=401) collapsed to 0.376243 — too restrictive/badly scaled.

Generation 2: p0011 (L-BFGS-B on log-heights from p0006 and upsampled versions, N in {50,100,200,400}) reached 0.834950 (+0.0016); p0013 (coordinate/pattern search) 0.833411; p0009 (sparse-support editing + L-BFGS from p0005) 0.824172. Mutations p0010/p0008/p0012 barely moved. Conclusion: dense p0006 basin near local optimum; refinement gains ~0.001–0.003.

Best line: p0006 — dense N=50 asymmetric smooth profile (max/mean ~2.5, f*f peak ~0.75 of support), score 0.834950 via p0011. Sparse branch (p0005/p0009) tops ~0.824, clearly below dense.

Generation 3: p0018 (exact analytic subgradient replacing finite differences) reached 0.855700 (+0.02075), N=200, max/mean 3.30, f*f max at 0.713. p0017 (logsumexp smooth-max homotopy, beta annealed 20→5000) was the breakthrough: 0.879272 (+0.044322), N=50, max/mean 6.77, very flat f*f top (42.57% of knots within 0.1% of max), max at 0.740. p0019 (adaptive step splitting/merging) only 0.835108. Mutations: p0015 0.837891, p0014 0.833522, p0016 0.835109.

Generation 4: p0020 (analytic-gradient logsumexp at higher beta/N) matched p0017 exactly at 0.879272, no gain. p0025 (p-norm max homotopy, p=4..256) also 0.879272, no gain. p0022 (exact-R subgradient polish of smooth solution) FAILED with a broadcasting ValueError in R_and_grad (shape mismatch 51 vs 100). Mutations: p0021 (finer grid N up to 800 + homotopy) 0.879272; p0023 0.835393; p0024 0.833543.

Open questions: whether a fundamentally different (non-local, asymmetric, or support-edited dense) structure can exceed ~0.879; whether exact-gradient high-beta continuation or a different smooth-max shape can squeeze past the p0017 plateau (both tried, no gain); whether the smoothing bias in p0017's solution can be removed by an exact-R polish (attempt failed on a bug, untested); whether sparse and dense regimes can be combined; true optimum shape and R unknown.
